projects.title: Northbound Coffee
projects.description: Full identity overhaul for a 12-location coffee roaster — logo system, packaging, and in-store signage.
projects.challenge: Northbound's old identity looked identical to three competitors on the same street and wasn't holding up on packaging.
projects.solution: New wordmark, a modular color system tied to roast profile, and a packaging kit that scales from bags to cups to signage.
projects.results: Same-store sales up 18% in the two quarters after rollout; brand recall in customer surveys nearly doubled.

projects.title: Vantage Analytics
projects.description: Marketing site and product demo for a B2B analytics platform, rebuilt for clarity and speed.
projects.challenge: The existing site buried the product behind jargon and a 9MB homepage; trial signups had stalled.
projects.solution: Rewrote the narrative around three core use cases, cut page weight by 70%, and rebuilt the signup flow.
projects.results: Trial signups up 3.1x within 90 days of launch; homepage load time dropped from 6.2s to 1.4s.

projects.title: Fielder Outdoor
projects.description: Season lookbook and product photography for an outdoor apparel brand's fall 2025 line.
projects.challenge: Fielder needed 200+ product shots and a lifestyle lookbook on a two-week turnaround.
projects.solution: On-location shoot across two states with a lean 4-person crew and same-day editing pipeline.
projects.results: Delivered on schedule; lookbook imagery drove a 24% lift in email campaign click-through.

projects.title: Loom & Co
projects.description: Headless e-commerce rebuild for a home goods retailer moving off a legacy platform.
projects.challenge: Legacy platform couldn't support their SKU growth and checkout was losing ~30% of carts.
projects.solution: Migrated to a headless storefront with a streamlined one-page checkout and saved-cart recovery.
projects.results: Cart abandonment down 22%; site handled Black Friday traffic with zero downtime.

projects.title: Currents Festival
projects.description: Positioning, messaging, and launch campaign for a first-year regional music festival.
projects.challenge: A first-year festival with no brand recognition, competing against three established events for the same weekend.
projects.solution: Built a distinct visual identity and a phased social campaign that leaned on artist-led content over paid reach.
projects.results: Sold 6,200 tickets against a 5,000 target with 40% less paid media spend than comparable launches.

projects.title: Hearth Studio
projects.description: Ongoing video and editorial content series for a home renovation studio's YouTube channel.
projects.challenge: Hearth had strong project work but no consistent content engine to show it.
projects.solution: Set up a monthly shoot-and-edit cadence covering three video formats, plus a written case-study library.
projects.results: Channel grew from 1,200 to 31,000 subscribers over 14 months of the engagement.
projects.technologies: Premiere Pro, video production, editorial writing
